title: The Cathedral of Light
summary: An ancient block-built forest at dawn with thick volumetric sun shafts through mist.
description: An ancient block-built forest in early morning, where low sunlight pours through gaps in the canopy as volumetric shafts into drifting mist. Pixel art rendered into a 270 px tall HDR buffer with nearest-neighbour upscaling, procedural 16x16 block textures and shadow-mapped light shafts. A self-running 30 second seamless loop with procedural audio; click once for sound. One self-contained HTML file with three.js. Built by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (1017) in DeepSeek Harness from the same prompt as the other entries in this comparison.
